title: Heart Rate & Heart Rate Variability Telemetry Report
subject: Chip Gowan
data_pipeline: Renpho Health -> Google Fit / Health Connect API

telemetry_overview.metric_methodology_note: Renpho Smart Ring syncs continuous 10-minute heart rate (BPM), SpO2, and sleep stages into Google Fit. Millisecond-level beat-to-beat rMSSD is processed internally by the Renpho Health mobile app and is not exported via the Google Fit REST API. This dataset includes continuous time-series HR, inter-sample RMSSD fluctuation proxies, time-domain standard deviation (SDRR), day vs. night circadian dipping, and overnight resting heart rate nadir (52.0 BPM recovery low).
